about.title: Lemoore Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a fatal crash happens on roads like N Lemoore Avenue, Rt 41, W Hanford Armona Road, or W Bush Street, the people left behind are often trying to grieve while also facing funeral bills, lost income, and unanswered questions. Kings County recorded a traffic death alongside dozens of injury collisions in the most recent reporting year, and Saturday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. see a noticeable share of reported crashes locally. A wrongful death claim is separate from any police investigation or criminal case, and it exists to help surviving family address the financial and personal losses that follow. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply connect Lemoore families with an independent attorney who can explain standing, deadlines, and what a claim might realistically cover. There's no cost to have that conversation, and no obligation to move forward afterward. You're allowed to take this one step at a time.

items.title: Who Can File Matters
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing mostly to a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. An independent attorney can help sort out where your family fits before time runs short.

items.title: The Clock Is Shorter Than You'd Think
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, but that window shrinks significantly if a government entity was involved. Waiting to ask questions can quietly cost a family its options.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond the Funeral Bill
items.desc: California law allows recovery for funeral and burial costs, lost financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. These aren't hypothetical categories; they reflect what a family actually loses.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case against the other driver?
items.answer: No, they're entirely separate processes. A criminal case is about punishing the at-fault driver, while a wrongful death claim is a civil action focused on the financial and personal losses your family experienced. One can proceed regardless of the outcome of the other.

items.question: My family lives outside Lemoore but the crash happened on Rt 41 near town. Does that matter?
items.answer: Where you live generally doesn't determine whether you can bring a claim; what matters more is your relationship to the person who died and where the crash occurred. An independent attorney can look at the specifics of the Rt 41 collision and explain how California's rules apply to your family.

items.question: What if we're not sure who was at fault yet?
items.answer: That's common, especially soon after a crash, and it doesn't stop you from having a conversation with an attorney early on. Fault often becomes clearer as police reports, witness statements, and other records come together over the following weeks.
